portal_description:
A daemon to share settings from GNOME to other applications. It also handles global keybindings, as well as a number of desktop-wide settings.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Sync minor subscription manager integration fixes from RHEL 9 (JIRA:RHEL-5074)

* Icons lost in zh_CN environment (JIRA:RHEL-4180)
